heroSubheading: Scheduled weekend and out-of-hours office removals across Birmingham, Solihull, and Coventry. Professional handling of workstations, IT equipment, and archive files.
summary: Minimise operational downtime with our dedicated commercial moving company. We provide comprehensive office relocations, desk dismantling, IT crate hire, server transport, and phased evening or weekend moves across Birmingham, Coventry, and the Black Country. Our DBS-checked commercial movers systematically label workstations, wrap delicate monitors in anti-static padding, and reassemble furniture at your new premises, ensuring your business is fully operational by Monday morning with zero employee disruption.
benefits: Out-of-hours, evening, and weekend moves to prevent business interruption
Computer crate hire, anti-static foam wraps, and server transit
Commercial desk dismantling and modular screen reassembly
Confidential document handling and secure archiving transfer
£2,000,000 Public Liability and comprehensive commercial transit insurance

process.title: Site Survey & Project Plan
process.description: We visit your current and destination offices, reviewing floor plans, building management protocols, lift access, and phasing requirements.

process.title: Crate Delivery & IT Labeling
process.description: We deliver heavy-duty sealable commercial crates and color-coded labels for each employee workstation and IT peripheral set.

process.title: Out-of-Hours Relocation
process.description: Our team dismantles furniture, protects IT gear in dedicated computer crates, and transports everything according to strict timelines.

process.title: Floor Plan Placement & Sign-Off
process.description: Workstations, chairs, and filing units are reconstructed in exact accordance with your new commercial floor plan ready for trading.

whatsIncluded: DBS-checked commercial removal porters and technicians
Commercial plastic lidded crate hire options
Floor runners and lift cladding for commercial landlord protection
Full transit and public liability insurance cover
whatsNotIncluded: Network IT server cabling configuration or software patching
Commercial building dilapidations or ceiling tile repairs

priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a 5-10 desk small office relocation within the Birmingham metropolitan zone during standard business hours.

faqs.question: Can you carry out our office move over the weekend?
faqs.answer: Yes. The vast majority of our commercial clients book weekend moves starting Friday evening, allowing business operations to resume uninterrupted on Monday morning.

faqs.question: Do you provide plastic crates for employees to pack their desks?
faqs.answer: Yes, we supply heavy-duty, stackable plastic crates with tamper-evident security seal options, delivered 1 to 2 weeks ahead of moving day.

faqs.question: Are your removal teams DBS-checked?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our staff are DBS-checked and carry company photo ID, ensuring complete peace of mind when working in commercial premises with sensitive records.

faqs.question: Do you provide disposal or recycling of surplus office furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can provide ethical clearance and donation or recycling for unwanted desks, chairs, and metal filing cabinets through licensed facilities.
